title: Grilled Italian-Style Skewers
description: A quick and easy recipe for delicious skewers made with tofu, amazing sauce, and grilled to perfection. Perfect for a light and healthy meal.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.amount: 1 block, drained and cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together amazing sauce, olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Thread tofu, grilled skewers, and filipino-style marinade onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush skewers with sauce mixture, making sure to coat all the ingredients.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until tofu is golden brown and charred.
Serve hot, garnished with additional amazing sauce if desired.
